title: Recalling the exact wording
description: The prompts are hidden step by step, and the way answers are checked matches a word-for-word task.

blocks.text: For a role, a poem or a speech it is not enough to recognize a familiar idea among the options.

quote.text: This is really a great app as it allows you to memorize scripture using three different modes. The first is fully written scripture. The second is partially written scripture and the third is completely blank.

blocks.text: Split your own text into fragments, leave the first letters or chosen anchors, then take them away. Show the differences from the original after an attempt.
